title: CreatedPaths
description: The plugin of paths as written into Mod Mallet's own folder.

light.description: Whether it is flagged as light.

masters.description: The plugins it names as masters. It loads after them.

notRelinked.description:
The re-attachments asked for that it does not make: a repair took
the triangle out, or the mesh, the triangle or the door was not
found.

path.description:
The archive that holds it, ready for the mod manager; empty if
nothing was written.

refused.description: The meshes chosen that it does not repair, and why.

relinked.description:
The door triangles it re-attaches from hidden doors to the doors
kept in their place (ADR 0088).

DoorRelink.description:
A door triangle of a navigation mesh that is to name another door: a
path of the characters re-attached from a hidden door to the door kept
in its place (ADR 0088).

from.description: The door it names now: the one the patch hides.

navmesh.description: The navigation mesh, by the plugin that first defined it.

to.description: The door it is to name: the one that stays.

triangle.description: The triangle, by its number in the mesh.

ObjectRef.description:
A placed object, by the plugin that placed it first and its number in
that plugin. Unlike a form ID as the game shows it, this does not
depend on the load order.

localId.description: The object's number in that plugin.

PathRefusal.description: Why a mesh is not repaired.

oneOf.description:
Nothing over hidden objects runs on it any more, or it was not
found where the repair was asked for.

Its cell or worldspace has a field Mod Mallet does not know how to
copy.

field.description: The record type and the field, such as `CELL XCWT`.

oneOf.description:
Its cell or worldspace was not found, or names a plugin the patch
cannot name.
The game is not one whose plugins Mod Mallet can write.

RefusedPath.description: A mesh that was chosen for repair but is not repaired.
